query:
SELECT DISTINCT o.user_id AS "user_id!"
           FROM enrollment_observees o
           JOIN enrollments e ON e.org_id = o.org_id AND e.id = o.enrollment_id
           WHERE o.org_id = $1 AND o.course_id = $2 AND e.user_id = $3 AND e.status = 'active'
             AND e.role_id = ANY($4)
           ORDER BY 1
